8   _   _   _ < 3   4   _   _   2
                    ∨   ∨   ∧   ∧
1 < 2   7   _   _ > _   _   _ > 5
∧                                
5 > _   _   7   _   _   _ < 4   8
    ∧       ∧       ∨   ∧   ∧    
_   _   _ < _   7   1   6   _ > _
    ∧           ∨       ∧        
_ < _   _   _ > 5   9   _   _   _
                ∧               ∧
_ > 4   _   _   _   6   3   _   7
    ∧           ∨                
_   6   3 < _ > _   _   _ < 9   _
                                 
_ < _   2   4   _   _   _ > _   _
        ∧       ∧   ∨   ∨        
6   1   8   3   _   _   _ < _   _

        for c in range(9):
            solver.add(grid[r][c] >= 1, grid[r][c] <= 9)
        solver.add(z3.Distinct(grid[r]))
